decisions.name: 孫越
decisions.author: Rico Shen
decisions.reason: Original inspected: a single older man with both eyes visible behind tinted glasses; microphone stays below chin and does not obscure lips. Strong caption/name/category/Wikidata Q9041952 correspondence, but tinted lenses may make eyes-only reveal difficult. Actual 600x720 game crop, five stage visual check, photo SHA, work hint and attribution not yet approved.
